input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Advance research programme hanger-codesign (track 18 draw): milestone 4e, the hanger arm-width decision on the calibrated triangle top tier against the 2D chain and 3D spring sheet, nine measured wovens (H1, H3).

errors.what: First T3 pilots from the flat 2D-chain start crawled for 300+ Newton steps
errors.fix: start T3 from T2's converged state; smooth the contact penalty's kink over 10 um (nodes resting exactly on the arm stalled Newton)

errors.what: 9 of 90 registered top-tier solves hit the 600-step cap (E1 refuted)
errors.fix: disclosed post hoc --extend pass with a 2,000-step cap, reported separately from the registered scoring

doc_friction.issue: Reproduce block said 79 tests; the suite had 93 before this run (earlier milestones added tests without updating the count). Fixed.

Milestone 1's 3,000-iteration cap on the 3 cm arm left the spring sheet about 0.1 cm short of converged (F5: 1.81 vs 1.93 cm); 1b says so, but the cap is still the default in hanger_3d.cloth3d.drape, a trap for any new comparison.
Bare python3 lacks numpy; /usr/bin/python3.13 had numpy, scipy and pytest, and pyenv.py printed it within seconds. Worked as documented.

deviations.why: One step per PR small enough to merge in this run: this step took about 12 core-hours (3.3 h wall on 4 cores) because the registered 90-case grid could not be cut after the predictions were committed.
deviations.did: kept the registered grid, ran it to completion, ran a disclosed extension pass rather than shrinking the design
deviations.result: landed in one session, with every registered prediction scored

notes: Registered predictions committed in 7785bfe2c before any registered solve. E2 (acceptance) held: top tier's arm width = spring sheet's on 9/9 uncalibrated, 8/9 calibrated; E3 held: = 2D chain on 18/18; E4 (H3) refuted: calibration never changes the top tier's choice; E1, E5, E6, E7 refuted. Local checks: 93 tests pass (pytest, /usr/bin/python3.13), research/_homepage/build.py ok, research_live_links ok, check_md_links ok, check_posts ok. Post hoc --extend (2,000-step cap, 2.2 core-hours): 6 of 9 capped cases converge, scores move -0.063 to +0.019 cm, no decision changes; 3 still stall at non-best offsets.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a PhD student building a contact-capable FEM cloth sheet, running 90 converged three-tier cases and writing up: about a working week

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
